scraped.scraped_description: import the target catalog into a local database;

name: soweego
known_funders: Wikimedia Foundation (Grant: FY 2017-2018, 75,000 EUR; second grant soweego_2)
dependency_risks: docs last built December 2021 — likely inactive
catalogs supported limited to Discogs, IMDB, MusicBrainz
academic_citations: Nechaev, Y., Corcoglioniti, F., Giuliano, C.: Linking knowledge bases to social media profiles. SAC 2017.
Nechaev, Y., Corcoglioniti, F., Giuliano, C.: SocialLink: Linking DBpedia Entities to Corresponding Twitter Accounts. ISWC 2017.
published_performance_metrics: precision/recall metrics for entity linking available in academic papers
documented_limitations: only three catalogs supported (Discogs, IMDB, MusicBrainz)
failure_modes: privacy/ethics concerns around automated identity linking
curation_criteria: trusted, professionally or peer-curated identifier catalogs
controversies: privacy opposition raised during grant review: concern that automated linking of professional and personal identity profiles without consent resembles surveillance/doxxing tools
ai_involvement: uses machine learning for supervised entity linking / record linkage
